title: DuckDuckGo launches a search option with AI features switched off
friendlyTitle: DuckDuckGo now offers search without AI features
summary: DuckDuckGo’s No-AI Search removes AI-assisted answers and AI feature suggestions while filtering AI-generated images from image results by default. It keeps the company’s private-search model and is also available through a browser extension.
friendlySummary: DuckDuckGo has made a version of search with AI answers and suggestions turned off. It also hides AI-generated images from image results by default.
whyItMatters: The launch makes user choice part of the AI product landscape: sometimes the useful feature is a reliable off switch. It gives people a straightforward way to separate conventional search from generated answers and synthetic imagery.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Not every search needs an AI answer. This gives people a simple choice when they want regular links and fewer synthetic images.
